title: Giant Ancient Snake From India May Have Been Super Long
summary:
About 47 million years ago, a giant snake lived in what is now western India. Scientists named it Vasuki indicus. It may have been one of the biggest snakes ever.

The discovery was described in 2024. Two scientists from the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee studied 27 fossil bones from the snake's backbone. The bones were found at a mine in Gujarat, India.

The snake was named after Vasuki, a snake in Hindu stories that wraps around the neck of the god Shiva.

The scientists did not find the whole skeleton. They compared the bones with those of living snakes. They think Vasuki was about 36 to 50 feet long. That is close to Titanoboa, another giant ancient snake. But the scientists say they are not sure which snake was longer.

Vasuki had a thick, heavy body and probably moved slowly. It may have hidden and waited for prey, like anacondas do today. Back then, Earth was much warmer.
why_it_matters: Fossils let kids and scientists picture amazing animals that lived long before any people.
